featured_reviews.name: Farheen Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Oscar Gaming Zone is hands down one of the best gaming spots around. The setup is top-class with powerful PCs, smooth controllers, and a lag-free experience that makes every game immersive. The ambience is energetic, modern, and perfect for both casual gamers and hardcore competitors. Whether it’s FIFA, Valorant, GTA, or competitive multiplayer sessions, Oscar Gaming Zone delivers quality every time.

What truly sets this place apart is the owner, Sabir Madhia. He is professional, friendly, and genuinely passionate about gaming. Sabir ensures everything is well-maintained, players are comfortable, and the overall experience stays premium. His attention to detail and customer-first attitude clearly reflect in how the gaming zone is run.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a serious gaming experience with a great vibe. Oscar Gaming Zone isn’t just a place to play it’s a place to enjoy gaming the right way.💯🎮

featured_reviews.name: Farman Khandwani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Been coming to this gaming cafe for almost 2 years now, and honestly it feels like a second home at this point. I’ve played at a lot of gaming cafes across Mumbai, and this one easily stands out not just for the setups, but for the whole vibe. The place is always comfortable, the systems are well maintained, and the gaming experience is solid every single time. But what really makes it special is the people. I’ve made friends here who feel more like family now, and that’s not something you find everywhere. The owner is super sweet and friendly, always welcoming and genuinely cares about the place and the players. You never feel like just another customer here. Overall, great hospitality, great gaming, and an amazing atmosphere. If you’re into gaming and want a place where you actually enjoy hanging out for hours, this is hands down one of the best gaming cafes in Mumbai.
Highly recommend 👌🎮

featured_reviews.name: Omkar Kinkar
featured_reviews.review_text: Timezone at Phoenix Palladium is hands-down one of the best spots in Mumbai for a fun day out. Tucked away on the Third Floor of the East Wing, it is incredibly easy to find and offers a massive variety of games that keep both kids and adults thoroughly entertained.The arcade selection here is top-notch. They have the latest immersive VR games like Virtual Rabbids and Dark Mars VR, which are absolutely thrilling. Beyond video games, the social play options are fantastic. We had an incredible time hitting the bowling lanes and driving the bumper cars, making it the perfect spot to hang out with a group of friends or family. It is also a very popular party venue, and I saw a dedicated area set up for a kid’s birthday party which looked well-managed.What really sets this Timezone apart are their incredible weekday promotions. If you want to make your budget stretch further, planning a visit during the week is a must. On Half Price Tuesdays, all video and ticket games are 50% off. On Fun Treats Wednesdays, the attractions drop to half price. Thursdays are a steal with bowling for just ₹99 and select games for ₹9, and Friday evenings offer great reload bonuses on their app.The staff is friendly, the environment is high-energy, and redeeming Powertickets at the Prize Shop at the end of the day is always a rewarding experience. It gets busy on weekends, but the weekday deals make it completely worth a mid-week visit. Highly recommended!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi Omkar! 🌟 Thank you for the wonderful shout-out! We're thrilled you enjoyed our blend of nostalgia and cutting-edge fun, along with the energetic vibes from our amazing team. Can't wait to see you back for more unforgettable moments! 🎉

featured_reviews.name: Tanishka Rajpal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Smaaash recently and had an amazing time! The place has a great mix of arcade games, bowling, VR experiences, and go-karting, making it perfect for a fun outing with friends. The energy and vibe inside are always lively, and there’s something for everyone to enjoy.

When I visited, they were also running a Beer Pass campaign which added to the excitement, but honestly the main highlight was the overall entertainment experience. The games were well-maintained, the staff was helpful, and we ended up spending much more time there than planned.

If you’re looking for a place to chill, compete with friends, and have a fun day out, Smaaash is definitely worth visiting. Looking forward to coming back again!

featured_reviews.name: Prathamesh Bandivadekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a great experience playing cricket at Smash! The setup and overall vibe were really fun and enjoyable. Everything was well managed and we had an amazing time with friends.

A special thanks to Sneha Lad for helping us throughout the experience. She was very polite, supportive and made sure everything went smoothly. Great service and definitely worth visiting!

featured_reviews.name: karan momaya
featured_reviews.review_text:
Celebrated my daughter’s birthday here and it was an absolute blast!

The venue offers a fantastic mix of arcade games, VR experiences, go-karting, dashing cars, trampolines and so much more.

While the kids had an extravagant time, we adults got a chance to relive our early college days making it just as fun for us!

The food was freshly prepared and absolutely delicious. From cheese corn croquettes to pizza, pasta, noodles and pav bhaji everything left us wanting more.

A big shoutout to the organizing team Hardeep and Rishab who ensured everything ran smoothly while keeping the kids’ safety a top priority. Everything we needed was just a clap away!

Also, special thanks to Arun for giving us the confidence that this was the perfect venue for the celebration.

All in all, we truly Smaaash(ed) it!

featured_reviews.name: Rahil Kotadia
featured_reviews.review_text:
Smaaash is a great place if you’re looking for a solid gaming and entertainment experience. From bowling and cricket to go-karting, there’s a good mix of activities that can easily keep you engaged for 5–6 hours.

They also have 3–4 good VR experiences that are definitely worth trying. The arcade games are decent, but you can skip a few of them and spend that time (and money) on the bigger experiences instead.

The space is well laid out, and even when it gets busy, the crowd feels manageable. Another plus is that the food here is good, making it easy to take breaks between games without stepping out.

One tip — check for combo packages or offers before you start playing. They can help you save a fair bit compared to paying for individual games.

Overall, it’s a fun spot for a long outing with friends or family.

featured_reviews.name: Pinkesh Kamwani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Smaaash Lower Parel — Still Brings Out My Inner Child
I’ve been visiting Smaaash Lower Parel for more than a decade, and it’s one of those rare places that has managed to grow with time without losing its core charm.
Back in the day, it was all about adult-oriented fun — late nights, high energy, friends, and honestly, partying like an animal. The go-karting, especially at night, has always been a personal favourite, along with the bowling arenas, cricket box, and a wide mix of adrenaline-packed games that made it a go-to hangout spot.

Fun fact: I’ve literally celebrated every phase of life here — I even had a breakup party at Smaaash in 2014, which somehow makes my bond with this place even stronger 😄.

What I really appreciate now is how Smaaash has evolved over time. Initially, the focus was clearly more on adults, but lately they’ve done a great job of introducing kid-friendly games without taking away the excitement that adults come for.
Last night felt like a full-circle moment. I visited with my 11-year-old nephew and 7-year-old niece, and they absolutely loved it. From the games to the overall vibe, they were completely engaged and having a blast. Seeing the same place work just as well for kids today as it once did for us adults was genuinely satisfying.
Smaaash still does what it’s always done best ,it brings out your inner child, no matter your age. And now, with the younger generation hooked, I’m pretty sure I’ll be coming here regularly again.
A place full of memories, that adapts with time and still delivers fun... Smaaash Lower Parel continues to hit the mark.
